dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast structures characterized by irregular, serrated light-colored perimeters. The gradient transitions from a dark base coat to high-intensity white/light-grey edges that enclose darker interior cores, specifically visible in a prominent central closed loop and a large dorsal 'U' shaped arc.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Concentrated density of amorphous, solid high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior-dorsal (neck) region. Low-density scattering of punctate, high-intensity dots occurs across the mid-lateral field, lacking internal intensity gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three primary macro-annuli in the central body segment form an obtuse scalene triangle. The longest vector connects the central-most 'O' centroid to the most posterior 'O' cluster, with an approximate 120-degree interior angle relative to the superior-dorsal 'C' structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Interaction with non-biological artifacts including a bare human hand on the posterior-dorsal surface and a cyan-colored nitrile-gloved hand on the ventral-posterior margin.
